news.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Sales with more than 30 integrations
news.description: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT for Sales, a plugin offering more than 30 integrations and capable of using customer data from Salesforce and HubSpot, among others.

news.title: Anthropic seeks a new product that can surpass Claude’s success
news.description: After Claude Code’s spectacular public debut, Anthropic has new financial resources. The company is now looking for an even bigger hit product and is exploring several sectors.

news.title: Welcome to New York’s Tech Bro-hemia
news.description: How a Brooklyn neighborhood went from hipster haven to “San Francisco East.”

news.title: AI boosts post saves from 41 to 57
news.description: A creator replaced one-off requests to their AI with a single goal: increase the number of saves on their posts. By analyzing 60 posts, the agent identified the value of posts ending with a practical next step, while leaving final approval to the human.

news.title: Saved posts reach 38% more people than liked posts
news.description: Hootsuite’s experiment compared saves with likes. Saved posts reached about 38% more people.

news.title: A guide explains what Instagram saves and shares mean
news.description: Colorado State’s guide explains what saves and shares mean, as well as where to view this data in Instagram Insights.

news.title: Slack details how Claude is used in messages and channels
news.description: Slack’s guide explains how to connect Claude and use it in messages and channels. It notes that Claude Tag replaced the original app on August 3, 2026.

news.title: Anthropic explains when to let an AI agent choose its own actions
news.description: Anthropic’s guide explains when a simple, step-by-step setup is sufficient and when it is better to let the AI choose its own actions.

news.title: Real-world examples improve Claude’s responses
news.description: Claude’s guide shows that providing a few real examples, such as past posts, produces more accurate responses than instructions alone.

news.title: Atlassian finds that AI speeds delivery without yet improving customer value
news.description: According to Atlassian’s State of Product 2027 study, 80% of product professionals believe AI helps them deliver faster, but customers do not yet perceive that value more quickly. The report also examines persistent limitations, including decision-making and reliance on instinct over customer data.

news.title: Google Genie 4 turns text prompts into explorable worlds
news.description: Google DeepMind has launched Genie 4, a model capable of generating interactive worlds from a description, then changing their weather or characters in real time with matching sound. Available through Project Genie to some Google AI Ultra subscribers, the tool is presented as a way to prototype environments, despite ongoing issues with camera latency and scene persistence.

news.title: Pika Enact lets users direct AI-generated scenes in real time
news.description: Pika has introduced Enact, an experimental environment that generates video and sound in real time as users position actors, give them directions, and move the camera. The tool offers interactive placement, text- or voice-based actor direction, and camera movements during generation, but is not yet available to the general public.

news.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon, a high-performing and cheaper coding model
news.description: Google has announced Gemini 4 Neon, a model positioned between Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Hydrogen. It ranks third on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and first in its Coding Agent ranking. Its API costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a one-million-token context window.

news.title: Anthropic explains how to use Claude Meetings with Google Meet
news.description: Anthropic has published a setup guide for Claude Meetings: connect Google Calendar, choose a Google Meet meeting, then click “Add Claude.” Claude can then create a whiteboard or document during the call.

news.title: Microsoft launches MAI-Image-2.7, an image-editing model
news.description: Microsoft has launched MAI-Image-2.7, a model specialized in image editing that ranks near the top of Artificial Analysis’s leaderboard for the task.

news.title: Technology outages revive emergency preparedness
news.description: A series of technology outages disrupted email, travel, investments, money transfers, and purchases. Although there is no indication of a coordinated cyberattack, the incidents are nevertheless prompting many consumers to stock up on water, propane, and other emergency supplies.

news.title: At Caltech, AI is upending mathematics education
news.description: At Caltech, students use AI so extensively that professor Yi Ni no longer grades assignments for correctness. Unlike AI-generated essays, mathematical solutions produced by these tools are difficult to detect.

news.title: Nvidia risks losing the engineers behind its AI dominance
news.description: Following Jensen Huang’s resignation, Nvidia faces the risk of losing some of the engineers responsible for its chips and technical systems. Analysts believe this exodus could jeopardize the company’s AI roadmap.

news.title: Fat from deceased donors turned into a luxury beauty product
news.description: After a 45-year-old woman died, nearly eight pounds of her fat was turned into alloClae, an injectable used in cosmetic surgery. According to a Business Insider investigation, that amount could support procedures worth about $200,000.

news.title: Business Insider real estate journalist becomes a real estate agent
news.description: Real estate correspondent James Rodriguez, who has covered the housing market for years, obtained a real estate agent’s license himself. He describes the process as surprisingly easy.

news.title: New York’s popular bars struggle to preserve their authenticity
news.description: New York’s unpretentious bars are struggling to stay afloat, threatening the city’s authenticity and identity. Adam Glenn, owner of Jimmy’s Corner near Times Square, is warning about this trend.
